classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding angles and sides, calculate a similar-triangle length and justify congruence using RHS.

spec.description: Nested triangles with horizontal parallel segments PQ and BC, matching parallel arrows and all supplied lengths.
spec.mathematics: P lies on AB, Q lies on AC; AP=2, PB=3, PQ=1.5 and BC=x.

children.label: i
children.prompt: Prove that $\triangle APQ$ is similar to $\triangle ABC$.

answer.worked:
$\angle PAQ=\angle BAC$ (common angle).

$\angle APQ=\angle ABC$ and $\angle AQP=\angle ACB$ (corresponding angles, $PQ\parallel BC$).

Therefore $\triangle APQ\sim\triangle ABC$ (AAA), with matching vertices $A\leftrightarrow A$, $P\leftrightarrow B$, $Q\leftrightarrow C$.

$AB=2+3=5\text{ cm}$.

Using corresponding sides of the similar triangles,
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{1.5}&=\frac{5}{2}\\x&=1.5\times\frac{5}{2}\\x&=3.75\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: In the figure shown, $PM\perp RS$ and $PR=PS$. Prove that $\triangle PMR\equiv\triangle PMS$.

spec.description: Isosceles triangle PRS with altitude PM, equal-side ticks and the right-angle marker in sector RMP.
spec.mathematics: PR=PS; M lies on RS and PM is perpendicular to RS.

answer.worked:
In $\triangle PMR$ and $\triangle PMS$:

$\angle PMR=\angle PMS=90^\circ$ ($PM\perp RS$).

$PR=PS$ (given hypotenuses).

$PM=PM$ (common side).

Therefore $\triangle PMR\equiv\triangle PMS$ (RHS).
